questions.prompt: How do you deploy a charm named 'ubuntu' under the custom application alias 'worker-app'?
questions.explanation: The second positional argument to 'juju deploy' specifies the custom application alias.

questions.prompt: Which flag is used to deploy a unit directly onto an existing machine ID (e.g., machine 0)?
questions.explanation: The '--to <target>' flag instructs Juju to place the unit onto an existing machine or container.

questions.prompt: Which flag allows deploying an application with 3 initial units at deploy time?
questions.explanation: '-n' or '--num-units' sets the initial unit count for the deployment.
